rationale: Calculated per-scenario LCOE using: soft_cost = sum(component * multiplier), capex = system_size * (hard_cost + soft_cost), annual_cost = capex*CRF + fixed_OM*system_size, LCOE = annual_cost/annual_energy. Quantiles computed with linear interpolation on sorted values [61.90, 64.55, 66.46, 67.37, 69.82]: p10 at position 1.4, p50 at position 3, p90 at position 4.6.
